title: [AUG-12] Replace misleading Sound Device selector with system audio toggle
why_we_need_this: The "Sound Device" dropdown in FileUpload.tsx lists audiooutput devices but selecting any value triggers getDisplayMedia() — a screen sharing prompt. The selectedSoundId value isn't used in the actual call. Users expect device selection, not a screen sharing dialog.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] "Sound Device" dropdown replaced with a checkbox/toggle: "Capture system audio"
- [ ] Tooltip or helper text explains: "Captures system audio via screen sharing — you'll be asked to share a tab or screen"
- [ ] Checking the toggle still triggers getDisplayMedia() flow on record start
- [ ] Unchecking records mic-only as before
- [ ] No misleading output device list is shown
